articles.title_en: Shaping inequality and intergenerational persistence of poverty: Free college or better schools?
articles.title_cn: 塑造不平等与贫困的代际持续性：免费大学还是更好的学校？
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the aggregate, distributional and welfare consequences of alternative government education policies to encourage college completion, such as making college free and improving funding for public schooling. To do so, we construct a general equilibrium overlapping generations model with intergenerational linkages, a higher education choice as well as a multi-stage human capital production process during childhood and adolescence with parental and government schooling investments. The model features rich cross-sectional heterogeneity, distinguishes between single and married parents, and is disciplined by US household survey data on income, wealth, education and time use. Studying the transitions induced by unexpected policy reforms we show that the “free college” and the “better schools” reform generate significant welfare gains, which take time to materialize and are lower in general than in partial equilibrium. It is optimal to combine both reforms: tuition subsidies make college affordable even for children from poorer parental backgrounds and better schools increase human capital thereby reducing dropout risk.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了替代性政府教育政策（如免费大学和增加公立学校教育经费）对鼓励大学完成度的总体、分配和福利后果。为此，我们构建了一个具有代际联系、高等教育选择以及儿童和青少年时期多阶段人力资本生产过程（包含父母和政府的教育投资）的一般均衡重叠世代模型。该模型具有丰富的横截面异质性，区分单亲父母和已婚父母，并以美国住户调查数据（涵盖收入、财富、教育和时间使用）为约束。通过研究意外政策改革引发的转型，我们表明“免费大学”和“更好的学校”改革能产生显著的福利收益，但这些收益需要时间才能显现，且总体均衡中的收益低于局部均衡。将两种改革结合是最优的：学费补贴使来自较贫困父母背景的儿童也能负担得起大学，而更好的学校则通过提高人力资本来降低辍学风险。

articles.title_en: Joint search over the life cycle
articles.title_cn: 生命周期中的联合搜寻
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence that the added worker effect – labor force entry upon spousal job loss – is stronger for young than old households. Using a life cycle model of two-member households in a frictional labor market, we study whether this age-dependency is driven by heterogeneous needs for or availability of spousal insurance. Our framework endogenizes asset and human capital accumulation, as well as arrival rates of job offers, and is disciplined against U.S. micro data. Counterfactuals show a strong complementarity across both margins: A large added worker effect requires both high spousal earnings potential relative to the primary earner and limited access to other means of self-insurance. Together, both margins account for the observed age differential in the added worker effect. The model predicts substantial crowding out of spousal labor supply responses by unemployment benefit extensions among young households, in line with their stronger insurance motive.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供的证据表明，附加工人效应——即配偶失业后劳动力市场进入——在年轻家庭中比在年长家庭中更为显著。利用摩擦性劳动力市场中双成员家庭的生命周期模型，我们研究这种年龄依赖性是否由配偶保险需求的异质性或可获得性的差异所驱动。我们的框架内生化资产和人力资本积累，以及工作机会的到达率，并以美国微观数据为约束。反事实分析显示，这两个方面存在强烈的互补性：较大的附加工人效应既需要配偶相对于主要收入者有较高的收入潜力，也需要有限的其他自我保险途径。两者共同解释了观察到的附加工人效应中的年龄差异。模型预测，在年轻家庭中，失业保险金延长会显著挤出配偶的劳动力供给反应，这与他们更强的保险动机相一致。

articles.title_en: Comments on “Income differences and health disparities: Roles of preventive vs. curative medicine” by Serdar Ozkan
articles.title_cn: 对Serdar Ozkan《收入差异与健康不平等：预防性医疗与治疗性医疗的作用》一文的评论
articles.abstract_en: •I outline how the model developed in this paper fits the broader literature on endogenous health evolution.•I provide discussion of how this type of models can be used to better understand the dynamics of health.•I suggest the avenues for future development of endogenous health models.
articles.abstract_cn: •我概述了本文所发展的模型如何融入关于内生健康演化的更广泛文献。•我讨论了这类模型如何被用于更好地理解健康的动态变化。•我提出了内生健康模型未来发展的方向。

articles.title_en: How to fund unemployment insurance with informality and false claims: Evidence from Senegal
articles.title_cn: 如何通过非正式和虚假索赔为失业保险提供资金：来自塞内加尔的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the welfare effects from the provision of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits in a context where formal workers represent only a small proportion of the labor market and informal workers can submit fraudulent claims for UI benefits. We model these features and allow for varying degrees of enforcement and different funding sources. We then estimate the model’s key parameters by conducting a custom labor force survey in Senegal. Our findings show that the liquidity gains are large and the moral hazard response to the UI benefits among workers is relatively small: an extra dollar of UI benefits yields a consumption-equivalent gain of 60–90 cents, which exceeds comparable estimates from U.S. calibrations by a factor of three to sixteen. We then show that the welfare gains depend on the program design: UI funded through payroll taxes delivers the greatest welfare gains but becomes infeasible when there are few formal workers and high rates of fraudulent claims. On the other hand, UI funded through consumption taxes delivers lower welfare gains but remains feasible with high informality and false claims.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在正式工人仅占劳动力市场的一小部分且非正规工人可以提出欺诈性失业保险福利索赔的背景下，提供失业保险（UI）福利的福利影响。我们对这些特征进行建模，并允许不同程度的执行和不同的资金来源。然后，我们通过在塞内加尔进行定制劳动力调查来估计模型的关键参数。我们的研究结果表明，流动性收益很大，而工人对失业保险福利的道德风险反应相对较小：额外一美元的失业保险福利会产生60-90美分的消费等值收益，这比美国校准的可比估计值高出三到十六倍。然后我们表明，福利收益取决于计划设计：通过工资税资助的失业保险可带来最大的福利收益，但当正式工人很少且欺诈性索赔率很高时，福利收益就变得不可行。另一方面，通过消费税资助的失业保险带来的福利收益较低，但在高度非正式性和虚假申报的情况下仍然可行。

articles.title_en: Comment on “How to fund unemployment insurance with informality and false claims: Evidence from Senegal” by Ndiaye, Herkenhoff, Cissé, Dell’Acqua, and Mbaye
articles.title_cn: 评论“如何为非正规就业和虚假索赔情况下的失业保险提供资金：来自塞内加尔的证据”——作者：Ndiaye、Herkenhoff、Cissé、Dell’Acqua和Mbaye
articles.abstract_en: This is a comment on “How to Fund Unemployment Insurance with Informality and False Claims: Evidence from Senegal,” by Ndiaye, Herkenhoff, Cissé, Dell’Acqua, and Mbaye.
articles.abstract_cn: 这是对Ndiaye、Herkenhoff、Cissé、Dell’Acqua和Mbaye所著《如何为非正规就业和虚假索赔情况下的失业保险提供资金：来自塞内加尔的证据》一文的评论。

articles.title_en: Occupational reallocation within and across firms: Implications for labor market polarization
articles.title_cn: 企业内部与跨企业的职业再配置：对劳动力市场两极分化的启示
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes how labor market frictions interact with firms’ decisions to reallocate workers across different occupations during labor market polarization. We compare the patterns of occupational reallocation within and across firms in the US and Germany in recent years. We find within-firm reallocation contributes significantly to the decline in employment in routine occupations in Germany, but much less so in the US. We construct a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics and find the model with different firing taxes can replicate the difference in firm-level adjustment patterns across these countries. We conduct two counterfactual experiments for each country, highlighting the different roles played by the within-firm cost of reorganizing the occupational mix and across-firm frictions created by firing taxes. The results suggest the latter plays a more significant role in labor market polarization. Higher firing costs would lead to greater and faster polarization in the US.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究分析了在劳动力市场极化过程中，劳动力市场摩擦如何与企业跨职业重新配置工人的决策相互作用。我们比较了近年来美国和德国在企业内部及跨企业职业再配置的模式。我们发现，在德国，企业内部再配置对常规职业就业下降的贡献显著，但在美国则小得多。我们构建了一个企业动态的一般均衡模型，并发现具有不同解雇税的模型能够复制这些国家在企业层面调整模式上的差异。我们对每个国家进行了两个反事实实验，强调了重组职业组合的企业内部成本与解雇税造成的跨企业摩擦所扮演的不同角色。结果表明，后者在劳动力市场极化中扮演更重要的角色。更高的解雇成本将导致美国更严重且更快的极化。

articles.title_cn: 单身、夫妻、时间平均化与税收
articles.abstract_en: We study consequences of tax reforms in an incomplete markets overlapping generations model in which male and female workers with different ability levels self-insure by acquiring a risk-free bond, “time-averaging” their life-cycle work schedules and career lengths, and possibly by marrying and divorcing. We study incidences of a flat-rate tax and in combination with stylized versions of a negative income tax (NIT) or an earned income tax credit (EITC). Tax reforms have diverse effects that differ by workers’ abilities, marital statuses, and ages. A new “ex post-ex ante” criterion helps us to sort through welfare incidences. The importance of labor supply responses at the extensive margin makes the EITC better for redistribution than the NIT.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在不完全市场重叠世代模型中税收改革的后果，在该模型中，不同能力水平的男性和女性工人通过获取无风险债券、对其生命周期工作安排和职业生涯长度进行“时间平均化”，以及可能通过结婚和离婚来进行自我保险。我们研究了统一税率以及与负所得税（NIT）或劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的简化版本相结合的影响。税收改革具有多样化的效应，这些效应因工人的能力、婚姻状况和年龄而异。一个新的“事后-事前”标准帮助我们梳理福利影响。广泛边际上劳动供给反应的重要性使得EITC比NIT更有利于再分配。

articles.abstract_en: We investigate different wage growth rates over the life cycle for poor and rich workers, and how they relate to the frequency and quality of job-to-job transitions. Using the universe of labor market histories for Austrian workers born in 1960–62 to, we show that workers who are at the bottom of the earnings distribution have higher employer-to-employer transition rates than richer workers throughout their life. Nevertheless, they work for worse- and worse-paying firms as they age and are more likely to undergo unemployment spells at all ages. We propose a structural framework with learning by doing and heterogeneity along five dimensions: initial level of human capital, learning ability, and job separation propensity on the worker side, and productivity level and quality of offered learning opportunities on the employer side. Our model replicates the wage gap and the difference in the frequency of labor market transitions we document in the data, and allows us to investigate several dimensions of heterogeneity in the quality of labor market transitions. We find that poor workers’ lackluster wage growth stems from a combination of deteriorating human capital, employment in low-productivity jobs, and scarce on-the-job learning opportunities. We then evaluate a policy which matches low-wage workers to high-learning employers. We find that ameliorating the learning opportunities early in a worker’s career has a non-negligible impact on lifetime earnings. The gains from matching with a better employer greatly increase with job stability, as lower separation rates limit human capital depreciation and improve the odds of matching with high-productivity employers in the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了贫困工人和富裕工人在生命周期中不同的工资增长率，以及这些增长率与工作转换频率和质量的关系。利用奥地利出生于1960-62年的工人劳动力市场历史的全部数据，我们表明，处于收入分配底部的工人在整个生命周期中，其雇主间转换率高于富裕工人。然而，随着年龄增长，他们为更差且薪酬更低的公司工作，并且在所有年龄段都更可能经历失业期。我们提出了一个结构框架，包含边做边学以及五个维度的异质性：工人方面的人力资本初始水平、学习能力和工作分离倾向，雇主方面的生产率水平和所提供学习机会的质量。我们的模型复制了数据中记录的工资差距和劳动力市场转换频率的差异，并使我们能够研究劳动力市场转换质量的多个异质性维度。我们发现，贫困工人工资增长乏力源于人力资本恶化、受雇于低生产率工作以及在职学习机会稀缺的综合作用。随后，我们评估了一项将低工资工人与高学习型雇主匹配的政策。我们发现，在工人职业生涯早期改善学习机会对终身收入具有不可忽视的影响。与更好雇主匹配的收益随着工作稳定性增加而大幅提高，因为较低的离职率限制了人力资本贬值，并提高了未来与高生产率雇主匹配的可能性。

articles.title_en: Discussion of “Singles, Couples, Time-Averaging, and Taxation”
articles.title_cn: 关于“单身、夫妻、时间平均与税收”的讨论
articles.abstract_en: This discussion comments on “Singles, Couples, Time-Averaging, and Taxation” by Hans Holter, Lars Ljungqvist, Thomas Sargent, and Serhiy Stepanchuk. This work represents an exciting new agenda, combining recent findings in the dynamic micro labor supply and retirement literature with key features of the macro environment by including general equilibrium feedback and a government budget constraint. We point to some areas where the specification could be improved but these do not detract from the key insights in this paper and the significant steps it makes toward building a coherent micro and macro framework for research on labor supply and taxation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本讨论评论了Hans Holter、Lars Ljungqvist、Thomas Sargent和Serhiy Stepanchuk的“单身、夫妻、时间平均与税收”一文。这项工作代表了一个令人兴奋的新议程，将动态微观劳动供给和退休文献的最新发现与宏观环境的关键特征相结合，包括一般均衡反馈和政府预算约束。我们指出了一些可以改进的规范领域，但这些并不减损本文的关键见解及其在构建用于劳动供给和税收研究的连贯微观与宏观框架方面所迈出的重要步伐。

articles.title_en: Comment on the alpha beta gamma of the labor market
articles.title_cn: 关于劳动力市场的阿尔法、贝塔和伽马之评论
articles.abstract_en: This is an excellent paper that illustrates a recent line of work that I think is both very exciting and very promising. It makes three important contributions. First, it documents tremendous heterogeneity in lifetime labor market histories across workers. Second, it shows that introducing novel sources of heterogeneity into search models can account for this heterogeneity. Third, it shows that the resulting heterogeneous agent search model provides important and novel insights into many long-standing and important issues. This paper represents an important first step in the broader agenda of building models that can account for the important dimensions of heterogeneity found in the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 这是一篇优秀的论文，展示了近期一系列我认为既令人兴奋又极具前景的研究工作。它做出了三项重要贡献。首先，它记录了工人之间终身劳动力市场历史的巨大异质性。其次，它表明将新颖的异质性来源引入搜索模型可以解释这种异质性。第三，它表明由此产生的异质性主体搜索模型为许多长期存在且重要的问题提供了重要且新颖的见解。这篇论文代表了构建能够解释数据中发现的异质性重要维度的模型这一更广泛议程中的重要第一步。

articles.title_en: Comment on: “Occupational reallocation within and across firms: Implications for labor-market polarization” By T. Mukoyama, N. Takayama, and S. Tanaka
articles.title_cn: 评论：《企业内外的职业再配置：对劳动力市场两极分化的启示》作者：T. Mukoyama, N. Takayama, 和 S. Tanaka
articles.abstract_en: In many developing economies, labor markets have undergone a significant shift, with a decreasing share of routine occupations (e.g., assembly line workers) and a growing emphasis on cognitive occupations (e.g., software developers). Mukoyama et al. (2024) attribute this transformation to technological innovations driving the reorganization of work. Complementing this perspective, changes in the skill composition of the labor force also play a crucial role in explaining this occupational polarization.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中经济体中，劳动力市场经历了显著转变，常规性职业（如装配线工人）的份额下降，而对认知性职业（如软件开发者）的重视日益增加。Mukoyama等人（2024）将这一转变归因于推动工作重组的科技创新。与此观点相辅相成的是，劳动力技能构成的变化在解释这种职业极化现象中也扮演着关键角色。

articles.title_en: The alpha beta gamma of the labor market
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场的阿尔法、贝塔与伽马
articles.abstract_en: We access a long panel dataset of US workers to document the extent to which individuals are heterogeneous with respect to their pattern of transitions across employment states. We find that heterogeneity is well approximated by three latent types: αs, βs and γs. Workers of type α leave unemployment quickly and, once they find a job, they are likely to keep it for more than 2 years. Workers of type γ find employment slowly and, once they do find a job, they are likely to leave it within 1 year. We use our empirical findings to calibrate a search-theoretic model in which workers are heterogeneous with respect to the parameters governing their employment transitions. We find that αs move quickly out of unemployment to employment because they have large gains from trade, and they are likely to stay on a job for more than 2 years because their productivity is similar in different jobs. In contrast, γs exit unemployment slowly because their gains from trade are small, and they are likely to leave a job within 1 year because they are much more productive in a small fraction of jobs than in the majority of jobs. We find that a negative shock to aggregate productivity leads to a large and persistent increase in unemployment that is mainly driven by γ-workers. The predictions of the model align well with the unemployment dynamics observed during the Great Recession.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国工人的长面板数据集，记录了个体在就业状态间转换模式上的异质性程度。我们发现，这种异质性可以很好地由三种潜在类型来近似：α型、β型和γ型。α型工人迅速离开失业状态，一旦找到工作，他们很可能保持该工作超过2年。γ型工人找到工作缓慢，且一旦找到工作，他们很可能在1年内离开该工作。我们利用实证发现来校准一个搜索理论模型，在该模型中，工人在决定其就业转换的参数上存在异质性。我们发现，α型工人由于从交易中获得较大收益而迅速从失业转向就业，并且由于他们在不同工作中的生产率相似，他们可能在同一工作上停留超过2年。相比之下，γ型工人由于交易收益较小而缓慢退出失业，并且由于他们在少数工作中的生产率远高于大多数工作，他们可能在1年内离开工作。我们发现，对总生产率的负面冲击会导致失业大幅且持续增加，这主要由γ型工人驱动。模型的预测与大衰退期间观察到的失业动态高度吻合。

articles.title_en: Income differences and health disparities: Roles of preventive vs. curative medicine
articles.title_cn: 收入差异与健康不平等：预防性医疗与治疗性医疗的作用
articles.abstract_en: I show that while the rich spend more on healthcare early in life, the poor outspend them by 25% from middle to old age in the US. Furthermore, the poor seek medical care less frequently but face higher risks of extreme expenses when they do. I develop a life-cycle model, incorporating physical and preventive health capital, along with features of the US healthcare system. Preventive health capital governs the distribution of health shocks, thereby controlling life expectancy. The model suggests that the rich spend more on preventive care due to lower marginal utility of consumption, resulting in milder health shocks and lower curative expenses in old age. Public insurance—covering large curative expenditures—inadvertently widens the life expectancy gap by hampering the poor’s incentives to invest in preventive health. Policy experiments suggest that expanding insurance coverage and subsidizing preventive care to encourage the poor to use healthcare early in life yield substantial welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 我表明，在美国，虽然富人在生命早期在医疗保健上花费更多，但从中年到老年，穷人的支出超过他们25%。此外，穷人寻求医疗护理的频率较低，但一旦寻求，他们面临极端费用的风险更高。我开发了一个生命周期模型，结合了身体和预防性健康资本，以及美国医疗保健系统的特征。预防性健康资本控制健康冲击的分布，从而控制预期寿命。模型表明，由于消费的边际效用较低，富人在预防性护理上花费更多，导致健康冲击较轻，老年时的治疗费用较低。公共保险——覆盖大额治疗支出——通过削弱穷人投资于预防性健康的激励，无意中扩大了预期寿命差距。政策实验表明，扩大保险覆盖范围和补贴预防性护理以鼓励穷人早期使用医疗保健，能带来显著的福利收益。
